scope: Single exploratory development continuation. Same CNN-LSTM-attention; R1 and R3 unverified.

architecture.initialization: fresh shared seed; no reuse of selected v1 weights
architecture.scalar_readout: a_theta = w^T context + b, before one Softplus application
architecture.readout_precision: final readout vector and bias, their linear evaluation and the output operator are float64; encoder and attention are float32

data.target: centered population standard deviation of 7 log returns; h=1; no annualization

innovation.handling: abort the run if any margin is below -1e-12; do not drop rows; clamp only numerical negative margins within tolerance to zero

distribution.u_scale: mean(U) on inner fit only; must be positive
distribution.y_scale: mean(sigma7) on inner fit only; must be positive

loss.auxiliary: negative log density of U/u_scale under half_Student_t(df=5,scale=s/u_scale)
loss.interval_status: nominal under the assumed family; not calibrated

training.head_precision: final readout weights/bias, preactivation and both additive/probabilistic operators float64; encoder and attention float32
training.schedule: interleave one epoch per active neural variant
training.epoch_selection: lowest development validation RMSE, tie selects earlier epoch

initial_bias_matching.target: mean initial predicted excess equals inner-fit mean(sigma7-sqrt(A))
initial_bias_matching.method: 64-step monotone bisection on final bias; bracket [-40,40]
initial_bias_matching.failure_action: stop and report; do not tune on validation
initial_bias_matching.target_parameter: d_fit = mean_inner_fit(sigma7-sqrt(A)); delta is reserved for the confirmatory practical margin
initial_bias_matching.bracket_validation: check that the target exceeds the scale-floor minimum and lies between the endpoint means before bisection
initial_bias_matching.precision: bias is stored and added in float64; both g128 variants share the exact same solved bias; additive head may differ

training.shared_initialization_exception: only the solved final bias may differ between the additive and probabilistic heads; equal mean excess does not imply equal pointwise predictions

proposed_budget.includes: all new fitting, initial bias matching, training, validation and local checkpointing
proposed_budget.meter_scope: same charged-execution accounting as v1; includes all new fitting and any conservative active-session/recovery charges; not total end-to-end wall-clock time
proposed_budget.publication_scope: publication outside the active execution counter and downloads can add uncharged wall-clock time; any charge applied during an active reservation still consumes both caps

decision.comparison: candidate against the lowest validation RMSE among the five fixed controls
decision.threshold_status: new exploratory continuation heuristic; not the final confirmatory delta
decision.if_budget_interrupts_any_recipe: incomplete pilot; no winner or continuation gate passed
secondary_metrics: high-volatility errors using the inner-fit target 75th percentile
NLL_U and nominal 90% interval coverage for probabilistic variants only

novelty.proposed_adaptation: conditional innovation label, induced sigma7 density, positive sigma-mean quadrature and joint loss on the unchanged backbone

execution.state_at_publication: software ready; no v2 market run performed
